Chapter 680: Chapter 13: Time Achieved (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 680: Chapter 13: Time Achieved (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

As for comprehending all 3,333 Demonic Evolution Paths? Among the hundred thousand members of the Magic Jade Tower, it’s unlikely even one could achieve that.

“You’ve arrived?”

Upon seeing Lin Yuan, Stone Statue Shen Ji immediately ignored the muscular Yuan Jin by his side and spoke with a smile.

Even Yuan Jin didn’t dare to express any opinions. In his view, the Lin Yuan before him was an unfathomable Eleventh-Rank Life, whom he could only hope to meet in this place.

If it were in the outside world, let alone him, even the Yuan Family he represented would find it extremely difficult to get an audience with an Eleventh-Rank Evolver.

So far, the known number of Eleventh-Rank Evolvers within human civilization definitely does not exceed a thousand.

...

A thousand… may sound like a lot, but relative to the vast territories of human civilization, it’s unknown how many Star Alliance domains there are for each Evolver to emerge.

And most Eleventh-Rank Evolvers of human civilization are concentrated on the Large Alien Battlefields; the remaining are based mostly in the Central Star Domain.

The Eleventh-Rank Evolvers in the surrounding four major star regions are primarily associated with the Nine Great Evolution Towers.

“I want to challenge the fifth layer,” Lin Yuan stated directly.

Now that he was acquainted with Stone Statue Shen Ji, he didn’t hesitate to speak his mind.

“Alright.”

“Go ahead,” Stone Statue Shen Ji nodded.

The entrance to the Nine Floors Dark Tower opened behind him.

Under the cautious observation of Yuan Jin, Lin Yuan entered the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

At this time, Stone Statue Shen Ji was watching the screens of the Fifth Layer of the Dark Tower.

Yuan Jin stood by the side, having no authority to see what was happening on the fifth layer, he could only stand respectfully in his spot, looking up at the faint glow emitting from the location of the Dark Tower’s fifth layer.

Very soon.

Stone Statue Shen Ji shook his head with a hint of regret, “So close.”

“So close?” Yuan Jin shuddered with fear.

Had he almost conquered the fifth layer?

According to the information of the Nine Floors Dark Tower, one would need to have mastered the Rule of Time to be confident in passing the fifth layer.

And mastering the Rule of Time, even among Eleventh-Rank Evolvers, signifies being among the strong.

The esteemed one from earlier was just a step away from comprehending the Rule of Time completely.

“I only just managed to pass the first layer when I broke through to the Ninth Rank…” Yuan Jin swallowed hard.

Having the talent and gifts to fully perfect a Demonic Evolution Path, he had barely managed to pass the first layer of the Dark Tower after stepping into the Ninth Rank.

Rustle rustle.

Just then.

Lin Yuan reappeared outside the Dark Tower.

“Give it some more time, and it should be about right,” Stone Statue Shen Ji spoke up.

Had it been any other Eleventh-Rank Life, he certainly wouldn’t have said this, as the final bottleneck of the Rule of Time was known to stump many powerful beings.

But for Lin Yuan…

Stone Statue Shen Ji had no doubts at all.

“Mhm.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Suddenly.

Lin Yuan glanced over at Yuan Jin, who was standing respectfully by the side.

Having spent such a long time in the Demon Jade Space, Lin Yuan had barely exchanged a few words with him.

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment; after all, Yuan Jin was a fellow human Evolver. Being the only two challengers in the Demon Jade Space, it was only appropriate to greet him.

Of course, Lin Yuan was aware that Yuan Jin was human and that he came from human civilization.

But Yuan Jin was unaware of any information about Lin Yuan; he did not even know whether Lin Yuan came from the same universe as his.

After all, anyone with a Magic Jade Mark could descend in consciousness to this Demon Jade Space, regardless of which universe they were from, as long as they were still within the same dimension.

“My lord…”

Yuan Jin was both anxious and fearful. What merit did he possess to have Eleventh Rank Powerhouse converse with him personally?

“You really don’t have to do this,”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, “We are both Ninth Rank Evolvers, so you may speak to me normally from now on.”

“Thank you, my lord…” Yuan Jin started to reply self-consciously, but then his mind short-circuited.

What did the lord just say?

Actually, you didn’t have to do that.

No, that’s not right.

That’s not the sentence.

Both of us are Ninth Ranks?

Both of us are Ninth Ranks?

Both of us are Ninth Ranks?

The burly Yuan Jin felt somewhat dazed.

Ninth Rank?

Almost breached the fifth floor of the Black Tower?

About to fully grasp the Rule of Time?

The burly Yuan Jin didn’t react for a long time.

Is this still considered Ninth Rank?

The burly Yuan Jin mustered the courage to express his doubts.

But he found that Lin Yuan had already left, leaving only the Stone Statue Shen Ji beside him, smiling at him.

“Did I… just fall into an Illusionary Realm?” the burly Yuan Jin couldn’t help but ask the Stone Statue.

As a Ninth Rank Evolver, even though he had just entered Ninth Rank, he had a fairly strong grasp of his own spirit and Spirit Will.

But the words he had just heard were too unbelievable.

So much so that he wondered if he’d fallen into an Illusionary Realm without noticing?

“There’s no need to doubt,” said the Stone Statue Shen Ji with a slight smile, “The one just now was indeed a life of the Ninth Rank, but also the strongest Ninth Rank life I have ever seen.”

“The strongest Ninth Rank life?” the burly Yuan Jin murmured to himself.

So, were all the words he just heard true?

Shock beyond words filled the heart of the burly Yuan Jin.

A Ninth Rank on the verge of fully grasping the Rule of Time?

What kind of freak is this?

Even within their human civilization, the Galaxy Master, who is hailed as the strongest genius in history, couldn’t possibly do it, right?

Even though the burly Yuan Jin was just a newly advanced Ninth Rank, he knew well that a Ninth Rank on the verge of fully grasping the Rule of Time is completely different from a Tier 11 on the verge of mastering it.

It’s a whole different concept.

The former is unimaginably more difficult than the latter.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

After attempting again to breach the fifth floor of the Black Tower,

Lin Yuan’s comprehension of the Rule of Time soared once more.

[Your perception is against the heavens; you have deduced the 2041st new model of the Rule of Time…]

…

[Your perception is against the heavens; you have deduced the 2043rd new model of the Rule of Time…]

…

[Your perception is against the heavens; you have deduced the 2045th new model of the Rule of Time…]

…

[Your perception is against the heavens; you have deduced the 2048th new model of the Rule of Time…]

…

[Your perception is against the heavens; you have deduced the 2050th new model of the Rule of Time…]

…

[Your perception is against the heavens; you have fully comprehended the Rule of Time…]

…

In a trance,

the world in front of Lin Yuan changed.
